task: rtl/alu16.sv is a 16-bit combinational ALU. op: 0 ADD, 1 SUB, 2 AND, 3 OR, 4 XOR, 5 SLL, 6 SRL, 7 SRA, 8 ROL, 9 ROR, 10 SLT (signed), 11 SLTU; shift and rotate amount is b[3:0]. Flags: z = (y == 0), n = y[15], c = carry-out for ADD and borrow for SUB (1 when a < b unsigned), v = signed overflow for ADD/SUB; c and v are 0 for all other ops. tb/tb_alu_smoke.sv is the block's smoke test. Make it signoff-ready with an input-to-output delay of at most 5.5 ns. Keep the port list.
